no_tuning: No constant is chosen on a test portion or on the evaluation set. This job introduces no threshold search, fitted parameter, training selection, or evaluation sweep; all constants are inherited unchanged. The inherited SERF-v3 selection design was motivated by earlier SERF-v1 test analysis, as disclosed in protocol_serf_v3.json.

retriever.score: w * cosine(visual) + (1 - w) * [d * cosine(dense) + (1 - d) * cosine(tfidf)]

evidence.rule: a called client returns its single best-scoring page; the returned pages are ranked globally and truncated to the page budget, which equals the call budget

seeds.federation_rule: public seed + client count + (0 for finrag, 50000 for visdom)

variants.base: Imported adapter unchanged, including its evidence score and abstention.
variants.+sel: Base calls, pooled SERF-v3 coverage selection over their pages.
variants.+stop: External base order truncated at the first subsequent client with share below 0.05; FedResolve unchanged.
variants.+both: Stopped calls followed by pooled SERF-v3 coverage selection.
variants.topB: FedResolve only: base calls and availability, budget best pages by evidence score; ties lowest page index.

stop_rule.first_call: Always call the first eligible external-router client.
stop_rule.denominator: All online clients with finite score in that round, including previously called clients. Only client choice excludes called clients. No renormalization over only uncalled clients.
stop_rule.UniversalRAG: Maximum over sub-questions of client maxima.
stop_rule.S2G-RAG: Client maxima for the least-covered sub-question in the imported gap_steps trace; called prefix is unchanged until stop.
stop_rule.FedResolve: Preserve fixed residual expected claim mass stop exactly. This is not a scalar softmax-share stop.

selection: Imported e2e_v3_adapter selection for public data; imported v3_select from gold_v3.py for evaluation. First highest evidence score, then highest blended score for least-covered sub-question. Float64 blend, fixed tie rules, evidence-score presentation order.

public.query_order: Existing split order; first N per setting under --limit.
public.metric_rule: Same set PRF and page-to-document conversion as run_e2e.py. Complete evidence is recall equal to one. Calls count called clients. Routing abstention clears delivered public evidence.

evaluation.inputs: Evaluation runner task and annotation paths and normalized cached embedding scores; input and cache hashes required.
evaluation.label_boundary: All decisions are materialized before annotation content is loaded. Annotation fields are consumed only by fixed item_metrics.
evaluation.cost: Evaluation item_metrics: certificate charge plus selected image file bytes. Serialized request/response bytes are null because the fixed runner does not define them.
evaluation.topB: Also reported for evaluation to make the SERF-only selection control available on both datasets.

aggregation.per_setting: Arithmetic query means; identical UIDs required for every panel cell.
aggregation.four_settings: Unweighted arithmetic mean of four setting means, separately for each public dataset, method, variant, budget.
aggregation.comparisons: FedResolve +sel minus every other method/variant at the same budget; include identical controls and topB.
aggregation.completeness: Reject duplicates, missing cells, incomplete UID pairing, missing settings, manifest mismatches.
aggregation.smoke: Descriptive subset only; never a full recorded-cell reproduction claim.
aggregation.limit: Optional --limit N retains the first N query IDs in existing file order per dataset and setting, after validating the source panel. A smaller existing smoke subset cannot be expanded.

statistics.interval: Two-sided percentile 95% interval from imported paired_bootstrap.
statistics.seed: Public seed for every public comparison; evaluation seed for every evaluation comparison; stable sorted UID order.
statistics.evaluation_binary: Exact binomial McNemar from e2e_stats.mcnemar on strict_success.
statistics.interval_counts: Per dataset, budget, control, metric: number of four settings excluding zero; report positive and negative separately.
statistics.multiplicity: Descriptive unadjusted intervals and p-values; no family-wise claim.
statistics.identical_variants: Report zero differences rather than dropping equivalent controls.

compute.scoring: Once per query per setting; all variants use identical views.

reproduction: Full run must reproduce all 24 full-scenario recorded SERF cells on recall, calls, pages, protocol bytes and routing abstention, with tolerance 1e-12. This does not check answer or generator metrics.
evaluation_cache_source: artifacts/formal_gold_v1/formal_results.json: cache_manifest_sha256; verify each artifact against the cache manifest
